children: Healthcare Services Group entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire all equity of NEXDINE Hospitality (NexDine and Xendella) for approximately $93.5 million, subject to customary adjustments, plus contingent consideration tied to post-closing performance. The company funded the cash consideration at closing from cash on hand. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, covenants and termination provisions. Management expects the deal to expand its hospitality and dining services footprint.
